limitations: Training sensitivity on consumed development windows. Unit leverage means the design can perfectly fit any training response at that date; it is not a claim of event accuracy or causal shock identification.
method: Design only: exact Fraction and NumPy rank of policy columns and full training design. Drop each newly observed nonzero policy date separately. Check exact membership of each event indicator in the policy-column span, plus SVD projection diagonal leverage. Do not read market targets, re-fit coefficients or select a variant.
